start.body: A short, honest walk through the carbon inventory job. Nothing is locked — work one station at a time, and finish it by doing the real thing in the app.

scenario.noMission: This station has no lesson for your path yet. Read what it covers above.
scenario.roleBody: This sets your path and the story you see. You can change it any time.
